user.title: ERM Zapad Outage Check
user.description: Checks the planned-outage PDF that ERM Zapad (Electrohold) publishes every day and notifies you when your area is listed for the next day.

data_description.keyword: Name as it appears in the PDF, e.g. Ихтиман or Обеля. Case does not matter; it must match a whole word.
data_description.notify_services: notify.* services to alert. Leave empty to only update the sensor.
data_description.check_time: Local time. The next day's PDF is usually published in the evening; the default 21:15 is after that.
data_description.base_date: Anchor for computing the daily doc_id. Leave the default unless the check reports a calibration error.
data_description.base_doc_id: The doc_id whose PDF lists the outages for the day after the calibration date.
data_description.drift_window: How many doc_ids either side of the computed one to try.
data_description.regex: Advanced. The default contains a keyword placeholder in curly braces, replaced by the keyword. Groups: 1 area, 2 start, 3 end.
data_description.sensor_entity_id: Entity ID of the status sensor.

error.keyword_required: Enter a settlement or district name.
